r18/class_pure_component.reason: [render-count] PureComponent render is logged once less: Krate updates the text binding without re-running render(); DOM and state match

r18/context_memo_child.reason: [render-count] the context value is plain and the text updates like React; only the memo child's render log differs, because Krate does not re-run component bodies (same as class_pure_component and hook_usecallback_identity)

r18/effect_cleanup_throws_boundary.reason: [order] after a cleanup throws, React still runs the failed effect's next setup before the boundary unmounts it; Krate hands the error to the boundary at once, so that setup and its cleanup never run. Sibling effects and the boundary fallback match

r18/hook_usecallback_identity.reason: [render-count] render counters kept in refs differ because Krate does not re-run component bodies; handlers and logs match

r18/hook_useid.reason: [id-format] useId strings differ (krate-1-Field-Field_c0 vs _r_0_); ids are unique and label/aria links work on both sides

r18/ref_callback_inline_list_reorder.reason: [ref-callback] React detaches and re-attaches the inline callback refs of every list row on each re-render; Krate keeps the refs attached when rows move, and still detaches the ref of a removed row

r19/action_state_sequence.reason: [entanglement] React holds the result of the first of two queued useActionState dispatches until the whole queue settles; Krate commits each result when its action finishes (the final state and pending flag match)

r19/optimistic_overlapping_actions.reason: [entanglement] a second form action that finishes while an earlier one is pending: React keeps both optimistic items until all overlapping actions settle, Krate commits the finished action's update at once (the rollback of the failed one and the final list match)
